decision.explanation: Both Bradley Joseph and Joe McElderry are explicitly identified as artists of an album titled "Classic Christmas" in separate documents. D1S1 and D2S1 directly state that Bradley Joseph is the artist of the "Classic Christmas" album. Similarly, D3S1 and D4S2 identify Joe McElderry as the artist of another "Classic Christmas" album. These are distinct referents (different people and albums), so both are valid answers.
